name: seo-audit-crawler
title: Technical SEO Audit & Site Crawler
description: Crawls a website and audits every URL for technical and on-page SEO issues, with cross-page checks, a 0 to 100 score and an HTML report.

keyValueStore.title: Report and summary
keyValueStore.description: What a run saves next to its dataset: an HTML report and a JSON summary of the audit.

report.title: HTML report
report.description: The site score, every issue with counts and example URLs, and the pages that need attention first. Open it in a browser or print it to PDF.

summary.title: JSON summary
summary.description: Overall score, status code counts, every issue with counts and example URLs, and what was found in robots.txt and the sitemaps.
